hero.subtitle: Hold a credential from a trusted issuer, generate an UltraHonk zero-knowledge proof locally, and verify your claim on Stellar — without the underlying data ever touching the chain.

how_it_works.title: How StellarCred works
how_it_works.step_01_body: A trusted issuer signs a credential to your wallet. It lives on your device — never on a server.
how_it_works.step_02_body: Generate a zero-knowledge proof locally in your browser. Only the claim leaves; the data behind it never does.
how_it_works.step_03_body: Any Stellar protocol reads ProofRegistry on-chain. One proof, valid across every protocol, for 30 days.

trusted_everywhere.title: Verified once. Trusted everywhere.
trusted_everywhere.subtitle: Any protocol on Stellar can verify your credentials in one contract call. Your proof is valid everywhere.
trusted_everywhere.direct_verify_body: Visit StellarCred before using any app. Your credentials work everywhere, instantly.
trusted_everywhere.verify_through_app_body: Apps that integrate StellarCred show a "Verify" button. Complete verification and return automatically.

developers.title: Built for developers
developers.verified_body: On-chain proof, read in one call. No backend needed.

cta.title: Ready to try it?
cta.subtitle: Connect a Stellar wallet on testnet, get a credential, generate your first on-chain ZK proof in under a minute.

welcome.title: Welcome to StellarCred
welcome.summary: Prove facts about yourself without revealing personal data. This walkthrough takes you through the full loop once: a wallet, a credential, and a proof anyone can verify.
welcome.tip: Your credentials live in this browser only — never on a server. You can replay this tour anytime with the

connect-wallet.title: Set up your wallet
connect-wallet.summary: Connect a Stellar wallet on testnet. Your wallet address is the identity your credentials are bound to — proofs are always submitted by its key.
connect-wallet.tip: Credentials are sealed to the address that received them, so use the same wallet every time. Nothing is sent to us when you connect; the wallet only shares its public address.

get-credential.title: Create your credential
get-credential.summary: Request a demo age credential from the StellarCred Authority. It attests
without carrying your date of birth — only a cryptographic commitment is stored.
get-credential.tip: The credential is encrypted at rest in your browser with a key derived from your unlock passphrase. Back it up from the dashboard before clearing site data.

verify-trust.title: Verify issuer trust
verify-trust.summary: Protocols only accept proofs from issuers registered on-chain. This check reads the issuer of your new credential from the IssuerRegistry contract and confirms its signing key is still trusted.
verify-trust.tip: A trusted issuer is what makes a proof meaningful: anyone verifying on-chain re-runs this same check, so seeing
here means your future proofs will be accepted.

generate-proof.title: Generate a proof
generate-proof.summary: Generate a zero-knowledge proof locally. Only the claim (
) and the proof leave your device — the data behind it never does.
generate-proof.tip: Proving runs entirely in your browser, so the first proof takes a few seconds to load the circuit. Onboarding stays available until you finish.

unlock.title: You're ready
unlock.summary: Wallet, credential, trust — the core loop is done. Any Stellar protocol can now verify your proofs in a single contract call.
unlock.tip: Explore apps that accept StellarCred proofs, or open your dashboard to generate a real proof on-chain.

active.label: Trusted
active.message: The issuer is registered on-chain and its signing key is accepted. Proofs from this credential will pass the protocol's trusted-issuer gate.

key_retired.label: Trusted (key retiring)
key_retired.message: The issuer rotated to a new signing key, but this credential's key is still inside its validity window. Proofs work now; the issuer's newer credentials use the new key.

key_revoked.label: Key revoked
key_revoked.message: This issuer's signing key was emergency-revoked, so proofs from this credential may be rejected. Wait for the issuer to install a replacement key, or get a fresh credential.

issuer_revoked.label: Issuer revoked
issuer_revoked.message: This issuer was permanently removed from the registry, so protocols will reject its credentials. Get a new credential from a trusted issuer to continue.

unknown.label: Couldn't check
unknown.message: The registry couldn't be reached right now. This does not block onboarding — the same check runs automatically whenever you prove, and you can retry here.

checkError.label: Check failed
checkError.message: The trust check hit an error. Try again — if the network is unreachable it will keep working once connectivity returns.

revokedGuidance.title: Credential from a revoked key
revokedGuidance.message: Your credential was issued by a revoked key. To continue using StellarCred, get a new credential from a trusted issuer.
